title: EVALUATE ... ALSO ... — multi-axis decision table; each WHEN matches a tuple
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DISCOUNT-TABLE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-AGE     PIC 9(3).
       01  WS-CUST    PIC X.
       01  WS-DISC    PIC 9(2)V99.
      *> EVALUATE ... ALSO ... is a decision table with TWO axes.
      *> Each WHEN matches a TUPLE of values. WHEN OTHER is the
      *> catch-all. The natural Java port is a 2-axis switch or a
      *> Map<Pair<int,char>, BigDecimal>.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           EVALUATE WS-AGE ALSO WS-CUST
              WHEN 65 THRU 999 ALSO "P"
                 MOVE 25.00 TO WS-DISC
              WHEN 0  THRU 17 ALSO "P"
                 MOVE 15.00 TO WS-DISC
              WHEN 0  THRU 999 ALSO "S"
                 MOVE 10.00 TO WS-DISC
              WHEN OTHER
                 MOVE 0.00 TO WS-DISC
           END-EVALUATE.
           STOP RUN.
notes: EVALUATE ALSO is COBOL's decision-table syntax — first match wins. Java rewrites usually use a chain of if-else; surface the first-match ordering AND the catch-all so the rewrite doesn't reorder.
